note: Public legal and published-rate facts only. This file contains no property-specific estimates or scenario inputs.

rows.label: Federal estate-tax filing threshold for deaths in 2026
rows.notes: Not a forecast for a later inheritance.

rows.label: California estate-tax return requirement
rows.value: No return required for deaths on or after 2005-01-01
rows.notes: Does not eliminate federal tax or income/property-tax obligations.

rows.label: California base property-tax levy and annual assessment factor
rows.value: Generally 1% of taxable assessed value plus voter-approved debt; annual inflation factor capped at 2%
rows.notes: Value declines, new construction, ownership changes, local charges, and parcel facts require separate review.

rows.label: Prop 19 adjusted family-home value cap for qualifying transfers
rows.notes: Do not project this allowance to a later transfer date.

rows.label: San Francisco secured property-tax rate, FY 2026-27
rows.notes: Not an individual bill; parcel assessment and direct charges vary.

rows.label: San Francisco allowable annual rent increase for applicable covered units
rows.notes: Unit coverage and future annual rates must be checked.

rows.label: Santa Clara County documentary transfer tax
rows.value: $0.55 per $500 or fraction of taxable consideration
rows.notes: Check whether a city transfer tax also applies to the actual transfer.

rows.label: San Francisco documentary transfer tax
rows.value: Tiered schedule from $2.50 to $30 per $500 or fraction
rows.notes: Recheck the schedule and taxable consideration at the actual sale date.

rows.label: Cal Water Los Altos tariff residential service charge
rows.value: $48.86 per month for a 5/8 x 3/4-inch meter; effective 2026-10-01
rows.notes: Only applies if the service address, tariff area, customer class, and meter match.

rows.label: San Francisco water and sewer tariff schedule
rows.notes: A customer bill depends on meter, class, usage, and parcel characteristics.

rows.label: California customer-generation tariff for new interconnections
rows.value: Net Billing Tariff generally applies to new applications from 2023-04-15 in the covered IOU territories
rows.notes: Existing system tariff and credits depend on its records and agreement.
